subject.title: fix(slack): time out stalled external file uploads

question: Is the earlier controlled live upload run sufficient for the later Enterprise completion-client refactor, or must current-head Enterprise proof be supplied before merge?
rationale: The post-proof refactor changes credentialed, team-scoped, one-shot completion routing; source review and tests support it, but they cannot establish behavior in the contributor’s real Slack setup.

options.title: Require current-head Enterprise proof
options.body: Keep merge blocked until redacted live output demonstrates the current head’s team-scoped completion route and confirms exactly one completion attempt.

options.title: Accept tests plus earlier transport proof
options.body: Merge while explicitly accepting that the later Enterprise completion-client route was not exercised in a real Slack setup.

recommendation.title: Require current-head Enterprise proof
recommendation.body: Keep merge blocked until redacted live output demonstrates the current head’s team-scoped completion route and confirms exactly one completion attempt.

likelyOwner.reason: The current assignee authored the Enterprise completion refactor and is best positioned to judge whether its live-proof gap is acceptable.
